item.title: CENTCOM confirms over 200 personnel injured across 7 countries in war on Iran
item.description: The number of US troops wounded during the US-Israeli war on Iran exceeds 200 across seven countries, according to a military spokesman.

item.title: Trump says US would have struck Iran even if he knew Tehran would strike Gulf states in response
item.description: Trump says US-Israeli war on Iran prevented a nuclear war while officials offer differing timelines on the war's duration.

item.title: At least 400 killed in Pakistani air strike on Kabul drug rehabilitation facility — Afghan official
item.description: Afghan government Deputy Spokesman Hamdullah Fitrat "there are serious concerns about a high number of casualties."

item.title: Last pro-Palestinian activist walks free as US government drops challenge to immigration bond
item.description: Leqaa Kordia, arrested after Columbia University protests, has been released after a year in US immigration detention.

item.title: Iran warns US could face 'another Vietnam' if troops deployed
item.description: Iranian deputy foreign minister says US troops could be dragged into a prolonged conflict if deployed.

item.title: Trump claims he can do 'anything I want' with Cuba as rhetoric escalates
item.description: US president's remarks come as Washington and Havana hold talks amid deepening crisis.

item.title: Middle East oil tops global prices as war hits supply
item.description: Dubai and Oman crude prices surge past historic levels as Hormuz disruptions choke supply and force Asian buyers to seek alternatives.

item.title: US aircraft carrier fire leaves over 600 sailors without beds amid the Iran war
item.description: A blaze on USS Gerald R Ford took more than 30 hours to put out, with dozens of service members suffering smoke inhalation, the New York Times reports.

item.title: France faces MICA missile shortage amid UAE drone interceptions
item.description: Intensive Rafale operations against Iranian drones have strained air-to-air missile stockpiles, according to French media.
